content: GIF optimization: target under 1MB per GIF, ideally 15KB-1MB; keep loops short (under ~5s); reduce dimensions to actual display size before compressing (1080p GIF is far larger than 480p at same fps); lower frame rate substantially reduces size (4fps ~50KB vs 24fps ~283KB for same clip); reduce color palette. Best practice per web.dev/Smashing Magazine: don't use GIF at all for anything longer/higher-fidelity - convert to autoplaying muted looping HTML5 video (MP4/WebM) instead, which is dramatically smaller for the same visual quality.
